annotations.text:
Start here — this artboard is live.

Tap a card to see it as configured, tap again to see it unset. What changes is the state line, and that is the point: it names what is lost by not setting the thing up rather than counting how much is left to do.

The three sheets to the right are where each card leads. Each one commits with the same ink square at the bottom of the phone.

The tension worth naming.

Setup was deliberately cut to one screen and one question, and its progress rail was built and then removed as furniture. Three optional steps could put it straight back. Left is that version, drawn fairly so the choice is a real one; right is what is proposed, and why.

The two arguments the ceremony is compressing.

Left: choosing a model provider is choosing who watches a password-reset flow, so the step has to say what crosses and what structurally cannot (ADR 0076 §1). Right: a share link and the access it carries are two different clocks, and the picker refuses the combination where the link outlives the thing it opens.
